note: The heights are the rates (b,a,c) = (theta_-,theta,theta_+), and the exponents agree. The Lean carries the bounds as `quota` for the label and `rootTest` for the difference, with `RateIs`/`RateLE` along a filter and `PriceAt` for uniformity, in place of M's norms and `preccurlyeq`.

snippet.text:
lemma for_plot [DecidableEq I] (i₀:I)(hG:G.Simple){W r D} (L': Package C W r D) (hk:Height C.S φ T k b)(hm:Height C.S φ T m c)(hj:Height C.S φ T j d) (hb:b<c)(hc:c<e)(hd:e<d)(t:ℕ)
    (hX:extentWithin φ T (fun i=>C.S.gridPoint (j i) ∘ u i) e)(hY:Kept φ T e (fun i=>C.S.gridPoint (j i) ∘ u i)) :
    ∃ A p : L→ℝ, ∃ Q:L→ C.label t, RateIs φ T p ((Z')-t*c) ∧ RateLE φ T A ((Z')-(t+1/16)*(c-b)) ∧ ∀ᶠ i in φ, Survival (C:=C) F (k i) (m i) (j i) (A i) (p i) x (u i) t (Q i) :=by

proof_context.conclusion: `for_plot` gives labels `Q` with rate `p ~ Z' - t*c` for the label bound, rate `A <= Z' - (t+1/16)*(c-b)` for the difference, and `Survival` of the configuration eventually, with Z' = (sum d) c + 4 card I (c-a).

snippet.text:
lemma funding (hk:Height C.S l T k b)(hm:Height C.S l T m a)(hj:Height C.S l T j c)(hT:Tendsto T l atTop)(he:b<a)(ht:a<c) (hΩ:∀ᶠ i in l, Push.GridApprox.room C.path.levels (k i) (m i) (lensScope C t)) :
    ∃ g o : ι→ℝ, RateIs l T g ((Z')-t*a) ∧ RateLE l T o (-(X')) ∧
       (∀ᶠ i in l,0<o i) ∧ ∀ᶠ i in l, PriceAt C (g i) (o i) t d s (k i) (m i) (j i):=by

proof_context.conclusion: `funding` gives `g` of rate `Z' - t*a` and `o` of rate at most `-X'` with `PriceAt C g o ...` eventually, where X' = (t+1/16)(a-b) - Z'.

structure PriceAt (C:Family G)(g o : ℝ)(n : ℕ) (d : I→ℕ)(s:(i:I)→ C.label (d i))(J m j:ℕ) : Prop where
    quote (N p:ℕ)(hn:j<N)(hm:J ≤ N) : ∀ (r:I→Site (C.side j p)), (∀ i,loops C j p (r i) (m+1)=0) → Next.Rank.Edition.Spaced (C.path.levels.budget j).B r →
       let V:= Cells.center C.S p hm 0; let f (i:I):=C.O N p (s i) ((C.S.toDepth hn.le p).embed (r i)); (∀ i, Cells.Interior (V.chamber 0) (f i))→ (∀ z:C.label n, Cells.Interior (V.chamber 0) (C.O N p z 0)) →
       ∃ z:C.label n, let g': Config G (C.side N p)→ℂ:= (fun u=>∏ i,f i u)-C.O N p z 0;
       Next.UVStress.quota C n m N p z ≤ g ∧ Cells.Interior (V.chamber 0) g' ∧ V.rootTest (C.beta N p) g' ≤ o

proof_context.conclusion: `PriceAt` gives a label `z` with `quota <= g`, interior difference and `rootTest <= o` for all separated lattice configurations.
